StowMind 1.3.1 fixes the shared icon cache review on the Agent cleanup page.

- Clicking "扫描 Agent" or "重新扫描" now also triggers the administrator review when the cache probe reports permission denied — previously it only fired after a complete-but-unauthorized measurement, so the scan appeared to do nothing on restricted machines.
- The bottom "清理已选内容" action still confirms Agent items and the reviewed cache together; no standalone clean button was reintroduced.
